A '''senator''' had a [[Unidentified senator's mistress|mistress]] who tried to write a tell-all book about the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate's]] secrets during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], until she was convinced to change to a romance novel.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Scorned}}</ref>
